application.scope: Selected contract Mark, exact book and Last before signed capacity; after an explicit signed capacity read, Mark for all related occupied positions and Last for all related nonzero cross positions. Other contracts subscribe aggTrade only, not unnecessary books.
application.account_read: Existing five explicit signatures unchanged; no provider starts a signed request or creates a wallet. All-account openOrders weight remains 40.
application.pricing: One public pricing boundary supplies manual conversion, buy/sell capacity previews, percentage input, attached exit resolution, review validation and final send guards. Revalue the recorded full-account facts; retain Decimal/Rational arithmetic.
application.bootstrap_wait: A fresh signed account may add price subscriptions. Wait for initial public snapshots without repeating signed reads; stop promptly on cancellation, form changes, concrete source failure/offline, expired account lease or disposal. Loading/cancel controls remain available during the wait.
application.freeze: Freeze original base quantity, direction, order terms, signed account facts and client ID at click/review. Subsequent prices revalidate the same quantity and exit terms; rising capacity cannot expand an approved order.
application.input: Manual raw input is preserved on price changes and errors. Percentage display updates only with valid fresh prices; during reads/signing or unavailable quotes preserve prior display and disable unsafe actions.
application.quote_times: Individual Mark/book/Last receipt timestamps label conversion references separately from private account receivedAt. Quote updates do not extend the original 30-second signed deadline.
application.wallet: Keep public sources active while an existing order operation holds the expected external-wallet lease. OS suspension may still stop delivery: ten-second receipt expiry and original signed deadline are checked synchronously after wallet return and before POST, without relying on a periodic emission.
application.anchor: Only price fields and quote timestamps may differ between a pricing context and the signed account anchor. Reject substituted wallet/configuration/funds/position/lease facts.
application.journal: Existing before-POST persistence and final canSubmit guard remain. Unknown outcome recovery queries the original identifier only, without a second submission.

transport_hardening.mark_rest_race: Per-symbol event revisions prevent late REST from reviving a malformed update received during bootstrap; unmodified symbols may complete independently.
transport_hardening.disconnected_marks: Ignore mark events until connected, and ignore duplicate connected notifications. Queued offline events cannot verify a new session.
transport_hardening.exact_quote_repository: Last-only mode skips the book bootstrap, channel and updates for related non-selected contracts. Existing clock calibration, transport/session isolation, channel revisions and replay protections remain.

verification_scope: Controlled public feeds and synthetic HTTP with actual production pricing/allocation/preview and signed submission repository; no real private, wallet, funds or address RPC requests. Legacy form fixtures explicitly supply bounded pricing; dedicated new tests cover the production pricing boundary.
remaining: Full account/order/configuration event synchronization and full signed account re-snapshot after reconnect; existing events invalidate bounded facts rather than merging a continuously fresh complete account
